rows.name: Food Trucks Portugal
rows.notes: Directory and event booking network exclusively for Portuguese food trucks.

rows.name: Foodtruck.pt (Venture 83)
rows.notes: Portuguese food truck directory; email is Cloudflare-obfuscated on page so use contact form.

rows.name: Street Food Market Austria Süd
rows.notes: Major touring street food festival & vendor collective in Austria (Stefan Roth - Head of Street Food Market Austria Süd).

rows.name: Reffen (Copenhagen Street Food)
rows.notes: Nordic region's largest street food market managing a roster of 50+ independent street food stalls and mobile traders.

rows.name: Aarhus Street Food
rows.notes: Permanent street food collective with 30+ independent kitchens and mobile food concepts in Aarhus.

rows.name: Foodtruck.dk
rows.notes: Denmark's primary food truck booking directory (67+ trucks listed); email is Cloudflare-masked on site.

rows.name: Vippa Oslo
rows.notes: Oslo street food hub and vendor incubator (also publishes booking@vippa.no on event pages).

rows.name: Street Food Polska
rows.notes: Poland's longest-running street food blog/media portal and organizer of food truck rallies (published as kontakt(małpa)streetfoodpolska.pl to prevent spam).

rows.name: Futraki / Iskra Events
rows.notes: Organizes the 'Futraki' food truck festivals in Poland; also lists damian@iskra-events.pl and ola@iskra-events.pl on homepage.

rows.name: Manifesto Market Prague
rows.notes: Cashless street food market collective operating in Prague (and Berlin).

rows.name: Street Food Park Bratislava
rows.notes: Monthly street food truck and vendor collective at Stará tržnica in Bratislava (lists contact person Jana Vašáková on homepage without direct email).

rows.name: Food Truck Show Hungary
rows.notes: Hungary's primary food truck organization and touring festival network assembling the country's mobile vendors.

rows.name: Street Food Festival Romania
rows.notes: Romania's largest touring street food network; maintains a dedicated vendor application page at https://streetfoodfestival.ro/food-trucks/.

rows.name: Athens Street Food Festival
rows.notes: Greece's largest street food trader gathering; active 2026 vendor applications via https://athensstreetfoodfestival.gr/en/diloste-symmetohi/.

rows.name: Thessaloniki Street Food Festival
rows.notes: Northern Greece street food and music festival managing a roster of street food traders.

rows.name: Odprta kuhna (Open Kitchen Slovenia)
rows.notes: Slovenia's premier street food market collective operating in Ljubljana and touring regional towns.

rows.name: APEFOODT (Asociación Peruana de Food Truck)
rows.notes: Official Peruvian Food Truck Association based in Lima.

rows.name: Asociación Mexicana de Food Trucks
rows.notes: Founded around 2013 in Mexico City to legalize and represent 100+ food trucks; no active standalone official website or verified current email found in 2026 search.

rows.name: Food Truck Center Chile
rows.notes: Chilean food truck operator hub and municipal advisory group; contact via website form.

rows.name: Hida Food Truck Association (飛騨フードトラック協会)
rows.notes: Regional Japanese food truck association handling vendor memberships and event dispatches via their web contact form.

rows.name: Truckat (تركّات)
rows.notes: Saudi Arabian platform and vendor guide organizing food trucks/carts; explicitly lists Yahala@truckatsa.com for partnerships/sponsorships and TechSupport@truckatsa.com for support.

rows.name: Turnup Food Truck SA
rows.notes: South African food truck event booking and mobile vendor network covering Johannesburg

rows.name: Asociación Argentina de Gastronomía Móvil (AsArGaM)
rows.notes: Pushed the 2016 mobile gastronomy law; co-founded by Rodolfo Cámara (The Food Truck Store). Source: forbesargentina.com/liderazgo/food-trucks-negocio-sobre-ruedas-n376; cronista.com. Find current Facebook/Instagram.

rows.name: Asociación Argentina de Food Trucks
rows.notes: Led by Ernesto Lanusse (Nómade food truck); quoted in a 14-10-2026 Perfil article. Source: perfil.com (por-que-los-food-trucks-no-pueden-instalarse...). Contact via Nómade's social accounts.

rows.name: Asociación Food Truck de la República Argentina (AFTRA)
rows.notes: President Luis Defelipe (Food Truck Argentina). Source: infogastronomica.com.ar. Find social pages.

rows.name: Associação Brasiliense de Food Trucks
rows.notes: Named as technical supporter of a SEBRAE food truck guide (with Abrasel). Source: sebraen2.tel.inf.br PDF; bdm.unb.br theses. Find Instagram.

rows.name: Associação Paranaense de Food Trucks (APFT)
rows.notes: Listed in a 2016 UnB thesis. Source: bdm.unb.br/bitstream/10483/15987. May be inactive; check Instagram.

rows.name: Associação de Food Trucks e Comida de Rua da Bahia
rows.notes: President Gabriel Lobo (Guerrilha Truck) in 2015. Source: portal.sescsp.org.br. May be inactive.

rows.name: Aso Food Trucks Bogotá
rows.notes: President Luis Fernando Tobián; runs monthly Bogotá Food Truck Market / The Food Truck Park. Source: larepublica.co. Find social pages.

rows.name: Asofoodtruck (Cali)
rows.notes: Association lobbying Cali municipality. Source: elpais.com.co. Find social pages.

rows.name: Asociación Ecuatoriana de Food Trucks (AEF)
rows.notes: Legally constituted ~2016; Facebook page referenced. Source: peru-retail.com/food-trucks-conquistan-quito. Find Facebook page.

rows.name: Asociación Mexicana de Food Trucks
rows.notes: Founders Maricarmen Linares, Edgar Núñez, Bernardo Bukantz. Source: timeoutmexico.mx; expansion.mx. Likely dormant; check social.

rows.name: Food Trucks DF
rows.notes: President Fernando Reyes; created 2013. Source: chilango.com. Check social.

rows.name: Asociación Internacional de Foodtrucks y Franquicias Móviles
rows.notes: Opened HQ in Morelia. Source: chilango.com. Check social.

rows.name: Malaysian Food Truck Association (MAFTA)
rows.notes: Chairman Datuk Mohamad Zaini Md Taha; active in press 2019–2022. Source: thesundaily.my; thestar.com.my. Find Facebook page.

rows.name: Kuala Lumpur Food Truck Entrepreneur Association (KLFTEA)
rows.notes: President Muhammad Azlan Abas. Source: thevibes.com (11 May 2024). Find Facebook page.

rows.name: SME Mobile Truck Association (SMEMTA)
rows.notes: President Datuk Wira Jalilah Baba; partnered with Star Media Group on a mobile truck rally. Source: foodtruckoperator.com.

rows.name: Sarawak Bumiputera FoodTruck Association (SBFA)
rows.notes: Source: theborneopost.com. Find Facebook page.

rows.name: The Food Truck Association (India)
rows.notes: Non-profit; president Shubham Chaudhuri; founded by Nikhil Vaswani (Pune). Source: restaurantindia.in; openthemagazine.com. May be inactive.

rows.name: Indonesian Food Truck Association / Jakarta Food Truck
rows.notes: Instagram @jktfoodtruck, Twitter @JKTfoodtruck. Source: miseenplaceasia.com; insight.jakpat.net. DM via Instagram.

rows.name: Food Truck Association of the Philippines
rows.notes: Launched ~2012 with Cucina Andare market. Source: awesome.blog. Likely dormant; check Facebook.

rows.name: Truckers DXB
rows.notes: Food truck movement/events in Dubai. Source: gulfnews.com. May be inactive; check Instagram.

rows.name: TLUNCH (mellow)
rows.notes: Food-truck space-matching platform (partner or competitor — not an association). Source: newswitch.jp/p/14593. Do not auto-send.

rows.name: Ruokarekkaralli
rows.notes: Touring food truck street food event in Finland. Source: visitporvoo.fi. Find organiser contact.

rows.name: Street Food Carnival Helsinki
rows.notes: Gathers 20+ street food vendors at Kaapelitehdas. Source: moottori.fi. Find organiser contact.

rows.name: kanpla
rows.notes: Powers online ordering and guest checkouts for Danish street food markets (including Aarhus Street Food's `menu.aarhusstreetfood.com` ordering portal).

rows.name: Storyous
rows.notes: POS and kitchen screen software heavily used by Czech and Polish street food vendors and Manifesto Market traders.

rows.name: Dotykačka
rows.notes: Cloud POS popular with Czech, Slovak, and Polish food trucks and mobile gastro stands.

rows.name: GoOut / NFCtron
rows.notes: Cashless payment and ordering system used across Central European street food festivals.

rows.name: FoodNotify / Orderman
rows.notes: Mobile ordering and POS hardware/software widely used by Austrian mobile caterers.
